turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have about twenty minutes, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Can I ask your advice as a mom?
You're asking me how to do your job? I'm here as Owen's mother, and I asked you a question. Who decided on the zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
My nephew lives with me and lies about homework constantly. How do you get through to a kid like that?
That's your household, Hale, and it has nothing to do with Owen. If you're comparing the two, I'm writing that down. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it was entered?
